title: PPG upstroke-fraction modulation does not establish incremental respiratory-rate accuracy in two public cohorts
abstract: Adding beat-normalized PPG upstroke-fraction modulation to five-modulation spectral pooling did not establish improved respiratory-rate accuracy: paired equal-record MAE reduction -0.1358 breaths/min (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.3550 to 0.0783) in BIDMC and -0.0307 (-0.3755 to 0.3511) in independent CapnoBase. Both intervals include zero; this is not equivalence or evidence of absent physiological information. Fixed algorithms used 53 adult ICU and42 adult/pediatric perioperative recordings, clustered by record. No model fitting or external tuning occurred. Both datasets were previously exposed: external transport, not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility is established.
